result_summary.title: Invalid token errors affecting Identity Vault access
result_summary.description: We are encountering 'invalid token' errors when users attempt to interact with the Identity Vault in the US-East production environment. This is affecting 237 users. The symptoms are inconsistent; sometimes standard access fails, and other times it seems related to emergency access procedures. We are unsure if the root cause lies within the Identity Vault itself or the underlying emergency access (break-glass) service which might be interfering with token validation. Please investigate the token generation and validation logs.
